epics.title: Work notes CRUD (itsm-api)
epics.notes: Implement GET/POST /incidents/{number}/work_notes with server-assigned collision-proof sys_id, unguarded authorship, and note_type validation.

epics.title: Incident lifecycle CRUD (itsm-api)
epics.notes: Stand up the Incident CRUD HTTP surface (GET /incidents, GET /incidents/{number}, POST /incidents, PATCH /incidents/{number}) as the first code this repo has ever shipped, scaffolding the FastAPI app itself alongside the Incident table and endpoints.

epics.title: User and assignment-group directory (itsm-api)
epics.notes: Serve a read-only, paginated GET /users and GET /assignment_groups directory over SysUser/AssignmentGroup SQLite tables

epics.title: SLA records list (itsm-api)
epics.notes: Implement read-only GET /sla with incident_number/breached/sla_definition filters and pagination

epics.title: Escalations list/get/update (itsm-api)
epics.notes: Implement read/update HTTP surface for Escalations (GET /escalations, GET /escalations/{number}, PATCH /escalations/{number}) with filtering, pagination, and null-safe ownerless-escalation handling

epics.title: API end-to-end test suite (itsm-api)
epics.notes: Add a real-HTTP e2e suite (own OS process, real socket, never TestClient) covering the full Incident/WorkNote/Escalation/TaskSla/directory contract, the PRD analytics-parity filter, and all three seeded discrepancies.

epics.title: Escalation and SLA MCP tools (mcp-server)
epics.notes: Add read-only list_escalations and list_sla_records MCP tools wrapping itsm-api's GET /escalations and GET /sla, with verbatim error passthrough and pagination pass-through parity with list_incidents.

epics.title: User MCP tool (mcp-server)
epics.notes: Add list_users MCP tool wrapping itsm-api's GET /users with a strict empty input schema per BEH-2

epics.title: Work-note MCP tools (mcp-server)
epics.notes: Stand up list_work_notes and add_work_note as MCP tools thinly wrapping itsm-api's WorkNote endpoints, with add_work_note remaining fully unguarded on created_by.

epics.title: Incident MCP tools (mcp-server)
epics.notes: Implement list_incidents, get_incident, create_incident, and update_incident MCP tools as thin wrappers over itsm-api's /incidents endpoints, with update_incident remaining unconditionally unguarded per Non-Negotiable Principle 5.

epics.title: Fixture seeding, all six tables (itsm-api)
epics.notes: Vendor portwell-assist/portwell-knowledge/course-shared sources at authoring time; seed incident, work_note, escalation, task_sla, sys_user, assignment_group idempotently, preserving the ten narrative tickets and reproducing all three seeded discrepancies.

epics.title: MCP end-to-end test suite (mcp-server)
epics.notes: Real MCP client over the real streamable-http transport against live itsm-api/mcp-server processes, including the unguarded create/add_work_note(assist)/resolve-with-open-breach round trip

epics.title: Escalations, directory, and nav shell (agent-ui)
epics.notes: Add the nav rail (Incidents/Escalations/Directory, default-active, client-side switching) on top of incident-console's static skeleton, plus the Escalations edit screen and read-only Directory screen.
